summary: Los Cabos is one of Mexico's highest-yield tourism markets, anchored by the Cabo San Lucas marina, Puerto Los Cabos and a dense luxury resort corridor along the 20-mile stretch to San José del Cabo. Demand is heavy on resort transfers, sportfishing and yacht charter. The Cabo↔La Paz / Espíritu Santo run (~75 nm) into the Sea of Cortez is a Quanta-LR trunk to a UNESCO marine paradise. High spend and a marina-rich shoreline make it a strong charter and resort-transfer market.
tagline: Baja's premium resort and sportfishing capital — marina-dense Cabo corridor plus a Sea of Cortez line-haul to La Paz.
